name: @ston-pulse/prediction-market-contract
description: Deployment workflow for the STON Pulse prediction market smart contract

scripts.build: blueprint build PulsePredictionMarket && blueprint build TonForecastMarket && pnpm exec tsc build/PulsePredictionMarket/tact_PulsePredictionMarket.ts --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly false --outDir build/PulsePredictionMarket && pnpm exec tsc build/TonForecastMarket/tact_TonForecastMarket.ts --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly false --outDir build/TonForecastMarket
